line_item_id.description: Set when the issue belongs to a specific line item. Null for receipt-level fields and for 'missing_line_item' and 'receipt' reviews.

field_name.description: Either an actual field name (e.g. 'total', 'quantity', 'staff_name'), or one of three sentinel values: 'line_item' (the row itself is wrong — merged, split, or invented), 'missing_line_item' (an item was missed entirely), or 'receipt' (extraction failed for the whole receipt — no candidate data at all; paired with flagged_reason='extraction_failed').

extractor_source.description: Which agent/model produced this candidate value, e.g. 'claude-vision-v2', 'tesseract-ocr'. For 'receipt'-scoped total-failure reviews, identifies which extractor failed.

extracted_value.description: What the extractor produced. Null for 'missing_line_item' and 'receipt', since nothing was extracted.

flagged_reason.description: 'extraction_failed' means the extractor produced no usable candidate at all for the receipt (unreadable image, vendor API error, etc.) — always paired with field_name='receipt'. The others all describe qualifying an actual candidate value.

status.description: 'rejected' is reversible — it means unresolved at this time, not permanently unrecoverable, and can move to 'resolved' later.

reviewed_value.description: For a single-field issue: the corrected value. For field_name='line_item': a full corrected line, or the literal string 'delete'. For field_name='missing_line_item': the full item to add. For field_name='receipt': the full corrected receipt data, once available (e.g. from a re-scan or manual entry).
